en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly residential area with large villas and greenery. A main street runs through the foreground, lined with walls and trees, while ornate mansions stand on the slopes to the right. On the hilltop in the distance a pavilion-like structure is visible. At the top of the card there is printed German text identifying the location as a street scene.
